english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something essential or inseparable from the thing itself, including intrinsic value.
Use this when the inherent quality is an inner or intrinsic feature rather than an outward or added one.

examples.english: This sense of fulfillment comes from the intrinsic value of the work itself, not from artificial additions.
examples.traditional: 呢種滿足感係工作本身內在嘅價值，唔係靠人工堆出嚟。

examples.english: Confidence isn’t something you can put on; it is an inherent strength within a person.
examples.traditional: 自信唔係扮出嚟嘅，而係一個人內在嘅力量。
